metadata.description: Repo-agnostic feature and bug-fix pipelines for omp, driven by a per-repo .omp/relay.md profile

plugins.name: relay
plugins.description: /relay-feature and /relay-bug lifecycle orchestrators (investigate, implement, test, review, docs-sync, PR/MR) with specialist subagents, plus /relay-commit, /relay-implement, /relay-review, /relay-grug and /relay-init
